## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.4`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueComputedPropertiesInData`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-computed-properties-in-data`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-computed-properties-in-data)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueComputedPropertiesInData": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow using computed properties inside the `data` function of a Vue component.

Vue runs the `data` function before it sets up the component's computed properties.
Reading a computed property there through `this` gives `undefined` instead of the
computed value.

Only code written directly in `data` is checked. Code inside a function created in
`data`, such as an arrow function stored as a data property, is not reported.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return {
      total: this.doubled,
    };
  },
  computed: {
    doubled() {
      return 2;
    },
  },
};
</script>
```

### Valid

```vue
<script>
export default {
  props: ["initial"],
  data() {
    return {
      count: this.initial,
      label: this.formatLabel(),
      read: () => this.doubled,
    };
  },
  computed: {
    doubled() {
      return this.count * 2;
    },
  },
  methods: {
    formatLabel() {
      return "Count";
    },
  },
};
</script>
```
